tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// dwigaṇayugar+ṇaṇabawar+dhan+dunāmasid+dham+p+rāp+tash+tsaturāshitiṃsap+taṅgaḍhaukatebidzahāram//

༄༅// grub brnyes brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba tshogs zung rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// dzam+būdrumenaliṅgas+yasad+d+wīpedharmasarbadz+nyaprasādabhāskritāṇāṃkiṃbiṣ+ṇus+thānenatul+yān+ta// ༄༅// 'dzam khyad 'phags phul du byung ba/ bu rkang 'thung gis mtshan pa'i// gling gi dam par kun mkhyen chos// snang byas rnams kyi bka' drin mtha'// khyab 'jug gnas kyis gzhal du ci// chos yan lag gsum pa'i gzugs can/ 'dul khrims kyi rtsa ba brtan// gzhan phan spyod pa'i yal 'dab rdzogs// rim gnyis zung 'jug 'bras bus dud// dngos grub legs brnyes gang dag byon// bzo ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ dang gso ba'i gom stabs bde// sgra tshad rig pa'i mche ba rno// mdo rgyud gdams pa'i khur chen 'degs// rig smra'i khyu mchog ji snyed dang*// rnam pa yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka'// 'jig rten snang byed bla na med// yang dag mkhas pa'i phrin las gsum// dbang 'byor gang dag byon pa rnams// mkhyen gzhi gcig gi chos du ma 'gal ba/ pas 'byor yang rmongs pas dbul// brtse bas 'khyud kyang chags pas btang*// nus ldan gyur kyang gzhan dag la// 'tshe med grub dbang brgyad cu bzhi// yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa/ de dag kun dang phyogs bcu yi// 'gro la gzigs pa sgrib med spyan// dkyus ring spros pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang slob mar bcas mang blta// rab rtog so so'i mdun na sprul pa'i lus// grangs med btud kyang yon tan che// bgrang bar ma nus yan lag lnga// dub pas sa la ngal bso bzhin// rang bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ sems sgyu ma byed po gang*// skad cig rnam pa'i stang stabs kyis// rnam rtog bag chags brtan min pa'i// snang stong mchod pa'i mig 'phrul ngom// mchod

rdzas rang bzhin brjod pa/ yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri chab zhal zas dang*// sgra snyan ma rnams rang rtags rdzas// bsnams shing sgyu ma'i rtse 'jos mchod// bdag lus 'byor pa rgya che ba/ longs spyod dus gsum dang*// 'brel pa'i dge rtsa ji snyed dag /sa gzhi ri gling nyi zla dang*// lha mi'i dpal 'byor tshang bar sprul// shes rab yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ 'khor lo'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// 'khor gsum mngon par zhen pa'i gzebs// yongs su dral te mchod 'os kun// dgyes par skyed pa'i yon du 'bul// dal bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ 'byor rten mchog bsam 'phel nor// gti mug lag pa dbang mo ches// sdig ltung 'dam du bskyur byas pa// stobs bzhi tshad ldan chab kyis 'khrud// 'phags ldan pa'i gzugs can/ dang so so skye tshogs kyis// legs byas zla 'od spros pa'i rjes// sems kyi kā shi mdzes dga' mo// yi rang grogs dang 'khyud pa thob// phyogs yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs/ bcur bzhugs pa'i chos ston che// kun kyang 'gro la sman slad du// thog mtha' bar dge'i chos kyi sgra// 'byin par ngag gi gling bus bskul// rtag par bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ 'dzin rnams gdul ba'i phyir// chos dbyings bas mtha' tshol bzhed pa'i// sangs rgyas 'gro ba mgon med ngor// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol// mang ba'i dpe/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge bas bdag /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// gter bzhin gdul bya'i bsam pa kun// rdzogs byed byang chub chen por bsngo// gal te shis pa brjod pa las cha shas can gyi gzugs/ sngon bsags las shugs kyis// dbang byas re zhig byang chub mchog /ster min de srid dal 'byor gyi// 'dod dgu'i ljon pa mchog gyur cig /sems kyi ldan pa'i gzugs can/ glang po 'dod lha yi// g.yo sgyu'i 'phrul la ma chags par// chos 'dul pad+ma'i skyed tshal du// bag yod rwa bar chud gyur cig

/thams cad mkhyen rab rtog pa'i rgyu yi gtso// snying rje shin tu mnyen ldan gyis// 'gro la lan brgyar dkris pa bzhin// byang chub sems mchog 'byong bar shog /sngags bsdus dang ma bsdus bsres pa'i gzugs/ spyod gser gyi 'khor lo yis// cir snang lhan skyes ye shes kyi// 'khor du bsdus nas rnam bzhi'i sku// zung 'jug rgyal sa zin par shog /de cha shas can gyi gzugs/ brnyes nas ni sku gsung thugs// sgyu 'phrul bkod pa dpag yas kyis// phyogs bcu'i gdul bya ma lus pa'i// chos rnga chen por bdag gyur cig /de skad smon rgyu ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ bdag gsung rdo rje// mngon du gyur min bden tshig mtshon// grub pa min yang lhag bsam mthus// gang smras don med ma gyur cig /nyi ngag don gyi dpe/ bzhin ston pas 'jig rten brgyan// de yi 'od bzhin chos rab gsal// 'dab brgya pas bzhin dpal 'thungs pa'i// bkra shis kun gyis dge gyur cig /ces bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen pos mdzad pa'i grub brnyes brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bstod pa'i kha 'gengs sam/ 'di kho nas logs su bstod kyang rung bar yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba gsol 'debs dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tshogs zung rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla 'od ces bya ba 'di ni ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa'o// // ༄༅// dwigaṇodadhipūranas+yamahāmeghanāmaprok+tawāgrat+nas+yagam+bhirāguror+yogapūdzanātsāraish+tsasahaibiharatisma// ༄༅// gsung ngag rin po che'i zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchod pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa tshogs gnyis chu gter rdzogs pa'i sprin chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// phyogs bcu'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen kun gyi// sgyu 'phrul tshul khrims bslab ldan rnam rol gyis// sems can re skong gya nom yon tan dang*// phrin las lhun grub bla mas rtag tu skyongs// tha snyad gtsug lag nyin mor byed pa nas// smin grol yid bzhin nor bu mnos kyi bar// drin chen slob dpon thams cad rgyal ba dang*// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob nges pa'i phyag bgyi'o// dus gsum rnam 'dren yongs las bla ma mchog

/bsod nams zhing du bsngags pa brjod de ci// 'on te bskal mang bsgrub 'os ye shes che// de 'dis skad cig gcig la bskyed mi nam// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma dman pa'i blos// dngos grub sgrub thabs zab mor legs zhugs kyang*// stong pa'i mkha' dbyings skad kyi nga ro yis// bos pa'i lad mo bsgugs dang cis mi mtshungs// mos gus mi dman skal bzang rā ma ṇas// 'dir brten tshogs bsags rgyud las nyer 'phos mda'// sgrib stug 'bod grogs gnad la bsnun te slar// dngos grub sī ha 'gugs byed 'di rmad byung*// de'ang gang zhig thar pa dam pa 'dod pas gzhi nges par 'byung ba tshul khrims kyi sdom pa skye ba nas/ mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub bar gyi bde legs dang yon tan thams cad bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas 'byung dgos te/ mdo sdud par/ slob ma bzang po bla mar gus ldan de dag gis// bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya// ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung*// zhes gsungs/ khyad par sangs rgyas thob pa la bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs dgos shing*/ de rtogs pa la thabs gzhan gyis rnyed pa ma yin par bla ma'i byin rlabs dang rang nyid de la brten pa'i tshogs bsags khyad par can bgyid par rag las te/ kye rdo rjer/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed do// bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes sogs rgyud sde rnams las rgya cher 'byung ngo*// bla ma de'ang dbang ma thob pa'i bla ma la gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs cung zad re 'byung srid kyang*/ tshe 'di'am bar do la sogs par 'tshang rgya ster mi nus/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su blta ba ni gsang sngags pa'i lugs yin/ dbang ma thob na gsang sngags pa'i tha snyad mi 'byung ste/ so thar gyi sdom pa ma thob na dge slong gi dngos por mi 'gyur ba bzhin no// des na dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log par thob pa'i bla ma la gsol ba btab na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'byung ste/

bla ma lnga bcu par/ dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang bar// shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis// bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya// zhes so// dbang thob pa'i bla ma la rang gis mthong tshul ji ltar byung yang sangs rgyas dngos dang dbyer med du thag bcad dgos te/ ba tshwa chu klung gi mdor/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na// nga nyid slob dpon gzugs kyis gnas// nga yin snyam du yid byos la// de tshe de la gus pa skyed// ces so// de ltar min na mthong tshul sna tshogs 'byung ba sngon gyi lo rgyus dag gis kyang shes te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dge ba'i bshes su byon pa la/ khyim btsun chos gos kyis thod bcings nas zhing rmod pa dang chang gis ra ro ba can du gzigs pa dang*/ nā ro pas ti lo pa nya gson por bsregs nas za ba'i smyon pa ltar mthong ba sogs mang du byung ste/ de dag gis slar mos gus bsgoms pa dang bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas grub pa brnyes pa dang*/ gzhan yang mos gus stobs kyis bla ma las kyang slob bu grub pa thob snga ba'i lo rgyus kyang mchis te/ dpal 'bras spungs pa 'bras so ba'i char 'bebs nus pa'i bla ma bas/ de'i nye gnas lo bcu gnyis kyi sngon du 'tshang rgya snga bar byung ba dang*/ bal po'i dpe ka bhi ha ras/ bla ma las slob ma grub pa thob snga ba sogs rgyu mtshan du ma 'byung ba gzhan las shes par bya'o// des na bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni lam thams cad kyi gzhi'am snying po shes par byas nas nyams su blang ba la 'bad par bya'o// ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul so so'i lam gyi rim par mthun pa'i gsol ba gdab pa la mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung yang*/ 'dir gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid gzhung gis dngos bstan zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len dang mthun pa'i yon tan rnams rgyud la skye bar gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul la/

sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po sbyor ba la nyer bsdogs dang*/ sngon 'gro gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang gtsang zhing rgyan gyis brgyan par/ stegs bu la sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga'am/ bla ma'i sku bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du nyer spyod dang mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi ltar bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod rnams 'dus bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs chu gnyis ma gtogs kye rdo rje ltar dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi sogs tshigs bcad ma'am/ de mi nus na mngon rtogs kyi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ yul bskyed pa/ yan lag bdun pa dbul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ dbang blang ba'o// dang po ni chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa'i ngang nas don yid la dran bzhin pas 'di skad brjod do// mdun gyi nam mkhar mchod sprin 'khrigs dbus seng khri chu skyes nyi zla'i steng*// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon// rnam pa rdo rje 'chang chen sngon po rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol// khro 'dzum sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams ldan ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings lhag grol// dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan spras 'phro 'du 'od zer drwa ba dkrigs// rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i phung lnga kun 'dus rgyal ba drug /khams lnga rig ma skye mched rtsa rgyus tshigs rnams rgyal ba'i sras chen brgyad// yan lag rnam dag khro bo'i dbang po yul drug lha mor dag pa'i bdag /de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor// gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge gsum mtshan thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul ba'i mod// rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs dbyer med thim par gyur// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar du khyod// thar pa'i lam ston bla ma kun 'dus dngos// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha tshogs nyid// 'jigs las skyob pa'i skyabs mchog gsum yang khyod// bar chad kun sel bstan srung yongs kyi gtso// dgos 'dod kun stsol nor lha kun gyi rje// kun 'dus khyod zhabs spangs nas skyabs gzhan la// re ba smig rgyu'i chu las 'thung 'drar blta// gnyis pa la bdun las/

phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan sdom pas phyug /mdo sngags kun mkhyen man ngag du mas brgyan// snying rjes rgyud brlan slob mar phan par 'doms// chos smra chos kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal// dus gsum bde gshegs yon tan srid pa'i mtshor// mi yi zla gzugs legs shar bde ba che'i// lhan skyes ye shes skad cig gcig bskyed pa// chos kyi rgyal po bla ma la phyag 'tshal// smra ba mkhas pa grangs med sprul dang mnyam// khyod kyi yon tan snyan dngags dam pa'i glur// blangs pa'i sgra dbyangs 'og min bar bkang ste// mngon par bstod kyin phyag gi phreng ba brtsegs// rnam dag dkyil 'khor bzhi yi 'dzin ma sogs nas/ bka' drin mnyam med grub chen bud+dha shrī// kun dga' bzang po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog rgyal mtshan shes rab rgya mtsho dang*// rgyal tshab kun dbang dpal ldan rdo rje'i zhabs// bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// sangs rgyas rin chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// sangs rgyas seng ge dkon mchog dpal ldan pa// nam mkha' dpal bzang kun dga' bkra shis dang*// kun dga' bsod nams rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan don grub ga ga na bud+dha// shes rab 'byung gnas dam chos bsam 'grub dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs tshul khrims lhun grub zhabs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yang na/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs shes bya bzang po dang*// bkra shis lhun grub rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs gang mos bsgyur/ zhes brgyud pa'i mtshan phreng gis phyag 'tshal ba'am/ mi nus na/ mdo rgyud bstan pa'i snying po phyung ba'i bcud// bdag med zhal lung tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi// dbang bskur zab khrid byin rlabs lung gi srol// brgyud ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/

gang zhig skyabs su nges par bsten tsam gyis// lam log 'jigs pa kun las skyob byed cing*// nyes med sdom pa yon tan tshogs bskyed pa// phyi nang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag ni// gang la cung zad phul yang don che ba// 'khor lo'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la// chu rlabs lag pa'i gar mkhan gaṅgā sogs// mchod yon zhabs rdul dag byed rgya mtsho 'bul// rkang drug 'phur lding gis rtsen ge sar tshogs// gad mo dgod snyam me tog ci yang bkra// lhan cig skyes sbyar dri zhim ngad pa dag /zhing kun khyab par ldang ba bdug pa'i sprin// sgrib pa'i mun pa za byed glal ba'i lce// 'od zer stong 'bar sgron me tshar du dngar// lhung lhung 'bab pa'i chab sgra yid 'ong can// ga pur la sogs dris bsgos byug pa'i rdzing*// ro bcud phun tshogs mtho ris bdag po la// stob par 'os pa'i zhal zas ri bo'i phreng*// dbyangs bdun skad kyi 'gyur ba glur 'jo ba'i// sgra snyan rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang 'bul// gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mchog brgya// reg 'jam 'dod yon phun sum tshogs dgu 'bul// sa gzhi lhun po ri gling lcags rir bcas// nyi zla lha mi'i dpal gyis phyur bur gtams// bye ba phrag brgya'i 'jig rten maṇ+ḍa la// yon gnas mchog la 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// skabs 'gar maṇ+ḍal bsags dgos yod na so bdun la sogs 'dir gsog go /skal dman sngon gyi lha yi yul min yang*// skal bzangs mi rmi yongs kyis bsten bya ba// dam tshig stobs bskyed mi 'chi bcud kyis len// dngos grub 'gugs byed bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul// 'jo sgeg 'phrul dang rgyan phreng glu gar rtsen// gling bu pi wang rdza rnga rnga zlum sgra// nyer spyod mkho dgu'i yo byad shis pa'i rdzas// kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bas mchod// gzhung lugs thos pa'i rgya mtshor bsam bsgom gyi// me tog tshal bzhad rang rig sgron ma gsal// tshul khrims dri 'thul yon tan ro brgya'i bshos// bzlas brjod rol mo don gyi mchod pas mchod// phun tshogs dge bas bskrun pa dal 'byor rten// 'byung khams ma 'khrugs bya ba'i khur bzod pa// bdag cag khyed kyi 'bangs su 'bul lags na// dgyes pa'i phrin las gang yin bsgrub par gnang*// de nas yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/

bag med long shor sems kyi skyes bu 'dis// tshim med nyon mongs dug lnga'i myos chu la// dbang med spyad pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams// thogs med gzigs pa'i spyan sngar bshags shing bsdam// 'phags dang so skyer gtogs pa 'gro ba yis// bsod nams rnam par bsags la dga' ba'i blo// me tog kun+dā'i dga' tshal stug po la// zla 'od kyis bzhin 'dzum zer dkar pos bsu// dgongs pa mya ngan 'da' la phyogs pa dag /yid srubs re ba bskangs la bdag dga' med// 'gro 'di ldongs par 'god na mi rung zhes// rtag tu bzhugs par bskul la mngon par spro// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rjes skyong ba// gang gi dpal mgur shis pa'i dung dkar las// 'phos pa'i zab rgyas chos kyi sgra bo ches// srid pa'i rims nad sel bar gsol ba 'debs// 'di ltar bskrun pa'i dge ba tshe rabs kun// skyabs mchog rje btsun bla mas rjes bzung nas// lung rtogs yon tan gter la dbang 'byor zhing*// mthar thug rdo rje 'chang sa thob phyir bsngo// gsum pa la gnyis las/ thun mong ba'i lam gyi gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sku gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod// nges pa lnga ldan go 'phang dam pa las// deng 'dir thabs mkhas sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol// sems can smin byed sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin// mu med phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod pa bas// mgon khyod sku yi cha rer ri mor bgyis// bsod nams lhag par lung gis rab bsngags pa'i// bden pa'i mchog des bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod// bdag cag rnams kyi 'bad pa chung ngu 'dis// thar pa'i lam sna zin dus ma mchis na// khyed kyi thugs rjes gegs bral yon tan rnams// yang dag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// mtho dman bar ma gang du skyes gyur kyang*// sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed sdug bsngal gyis// rgyun chad med par rtag tu sdug bsngal ba'i// srid las thar 'dod skye bar byin gyis rlobs// rnyed dka' don ldan dal 'byor thob dus 'dir// tshe 'di'i phun tshogs sgrub la ma chags par// long med 'chi ba dran pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// dam chos snying nas sgrub par byin gyis rlobs// mi dge'i las las sdug bsngal kun 'byung zhing*// dge las bde ba 'byung bar yid ches nas// lung ma bstan yang dge bar kha bsgyur te// blang dor tshul bzhin nus par byin gyis rlobs// thog med dus nas bdag gi mar byas shing*// phan mang btags pa'i mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// bde bar 'dod dang sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi// byams dang snying rje 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol nus pa'i// ded dpon bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub che// bdag gis thob nas 'gro kun srid mtsho las// sgrol 'dod smon sems 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// byang chub gegs dang sdug bsngal kun gyi gzhi// rang nyid gces 'dzin 'gong po 'dul ba'i phyir// bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// rgyal sras spyod la slob par byin gyis rlobs// rnam rtog mtshan ma med pa'i zhi gnas dang*// bdag med gnas lugs shes pa'i lhag mthong gnyis// mi 'bral zung du 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// thun mong lam gyi rim pa mthar phyin nas// zab mo'i don la nges pa skye ba dang*// 'bras bu'i yon tan thos pas yid spro ste// brtson pas myur lam 'tshol bar byin gyis rlobs// theg chen thun mong min pa'i skyabs 'gro dang*// smon 'jug sems bskyed sdom pas rgyud sbyangs te// rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// gsang chen lam du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi gsol ba gdab pa ni/

dran pa tsam nas phan bde kun stsol ba// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dbang dang dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol// lus la bum pa'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol// ngag la gsang ba'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol// sems la gsum pa'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol// rlung la bzhi pa'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol// rnam dag dbang gi cho ga las thob pa'i// mnyam rjes bza' bsrung mi 'bral dam tshig rnams// 'bad rtsol drag pos bsrung sdom nus pa dang*// nyes ltung dri ma med par byin gyis rlobs// gsal stong zung 'jug rgyu yi lhan skyes dang*// bskyed rdzogs ye shes lam gyi lhan skyes che// sprul chos longs sku 'bras bu'i lhan skyes rnams// dbyer med sems nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// rmi lam yul gyi snang ba ji snyed pa// snang mkhan sems las logs na med pa ltar// las nyon bag chags brtas pa'i phyi rol gyi// snang ba sems su rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i rta glang rnams// snang tsam nyid nas ngo bos stong pa ltar// rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba sna tshogs pa// snang stong sgyu mar rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// sa bon mi rtag myu gur 'pho min yang*// myu gu mi 'chad skye bar snang ba ltar// chos kun skye med dbyings las skye bar snang*// rten 'brel zab mo rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// longs spyod rlabs kyi bde ba myong ba ltar// sems dang sgyu ma rten 'brel 'gal med du// nyams su myong yang yod med las 'das pa'i// brjod bral gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// dngos kun byed po gzhan med sems nyid snang*// snang tsam rang stong sna tshogs rkyen gyis skye// skye med las skye 'gag med nyams su myong*// myong stong brjod med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'khor 'das tshang ba kun gzhi rgyu yi rgyud// smin grol nyams myong zung 'jug thabs kyi rgyud// lhun grub gnas gyur 'gal med 'bras bu'i rgyud// dbyer med lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// sku yi rdo rje sprul sku'i ngo bo nyid// sgro 'dogs yongs gcod phyi yi bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so lus la bum dbang stsol// bskyed rim lam bzang goms par byin gyis rlobs// ngo bo nyid gsum lta ba rtogs pa dang*// 'khor 'das dbyer med grub mtha' snyogs par shog

/tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na// gong nas gong du 'pho ba thebs par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma thebs na// lha sems dbyer med bar do'i gdams ngag la// brten nas rig 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs grub ste// sprul sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// gsung gi rdo rje longs sku'i ngo bo nyid// rang byung ston mdzad nang gi bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so ngag la gsang dbang stsol// gtum mo'i lam bzang goms par byin gyis rlobs// rang byung rnam bzhi'i lta ba rtogs pa dang*// ma 'dres yongs rdzogs grub mtha' snyogs par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na// 'od gsal dbyings su 'pho ba thebs par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma thebs na// gsal la rtog med bar do'i gdams ngag la// brten nas rig 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs grub ste// longs sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// thugs kyi rdo rje chos sku'i ngo bo nyid// lhan skyes ston mdzad gsang ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so sems la gsum pa stsol// pho nya'i lam bzang goms par byin gyis rlobs// lhan skyes dga' ba'i lta ba rtogs pa dang*// bde stong chung ngu'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na// rdor sems 'byon pa'i 'pho ba thebs par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma thebs na// lhan skyes bde ba bar do'i gdams ngag la// brten nas rig 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs grub ste// chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// snying po rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku'i dngos// de nyid ston mdzad mthar thug bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so rlung la bzhi pa stsol// dba' rlabs lam bzang goms par byin gyis rlobs// shin tu rnam dag lta ba rtogs pa dang*// bde stong chen po'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na// phyag chen lam nas 'pho ba thebs par shog

/gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma thebs na// bde stong mchog ye bar do'i gdams ngag la// brten nas rig 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs grub ste// bde sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// mdor na rten dang brten par gnas gyur gyi// sku lnga lhun grub zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang*// che ba gsum ldan bdag gis legs thob nas// mkha' mnyam 'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar shog /'gro kun nges 'byung tshul khrims rnam dag cing*// brtse dang byang sems gnyis su med blo ldan// gsang chen lam gyi rim pa mthar phyin te// sku dang ye shes phrin las rgyas par shog /bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dbang blang ba ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas 'khor gyi tshogs// 'od zer rnam pas 'khor lo'i mgon por thim// rje btsun bla ma'i gsang gsum yi ge las// dkar dmar mthing gsum rim dang cig car byung*// bdag gi sgo gsum rim dang cig car thim// dbang thob sgrib sbyangs sku bzhi'i sa bon bzhag /mgon de tshur byon bdag gi tshangs sgo nas// snying gi chu skyes lte bar dkar dmar khams// zla ba nyi gdan la bzhugs byin rlob cing*// rtag tu mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad par gyur// de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa ni/ dad pa dang mos pa rtse gcig pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i gnas lugs don gyi bla ma sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi rang zhal mthong ba'i ngang la ma bcos par bzhag go /gsum pa rjes ni/ de las ldang ba na/ 'di bgyis dge bas bdag sogs sems can kun// dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma lhag pa'i lha// dbyer med dad gsum sgo nas mnyes byed cing*// dbang dang dngos grub rtag tu len par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// ༈ //yang gal te bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mi byed par rgyun par chag med lta bu la/

shin tu zab pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor lam 'bras khrid gzhung nas 'byung ba'i don nyams su len par 'dod pas/ rnal 'byor phal cher gong ma de nyid gzhir bzhag nas/ 'dir mi 'dra ba'i dbri bsnan gyi khyad par brjod par bya ste/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gong bzhin byas/ dngos gzhi bskyed chog gi skabs kyi brjod pa/ rang gi spyi bor rin chen rang bzhin seng khri chu skyes nyi zla'i steng*// zhes sogs nas/ yul drug lha mor dag pa'i bdag /ces pa'i bar 'dra/ de'i rjes thogs su/ gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge gsum mtshan sogs dang sbrel te/ mngon par bstod kyin phyag gi phreng ba brtsegs zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de'i rjes su mchod pa'i yan lag rgyas par na/ gang la cung zad phul yang don che ba sogs gong bzhin brjod/ de tsam mi nus na/ gzhung lugs thos pa'i rgya mtshor bsam bsgom zhes sogs dang sbrel te/ gsang chen lam du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i bar 'dra/ de'i rjes thogs su/ dran pa tsam gyis phan bde kun stsol ba// zhes pa de mi brjod par/ de'i tshab tu/ spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan stengs su// zhes pa tsam bsgyur/ de man chad nas/ sku dang ye shes phrin las rgyas par shog /ces pa'i bar 'dra bar brjod/ de nas dbang blang ba ni/ de ltar gsol btab 'khor lo'i mgon po gang*// 'od phung bde ba chen po'i rnam rol gyis// bdag gi lus ngag yid dang ro gcig 'dres// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dbang bzhi thob// sgo gsum sgrib pa bag chags bcas sbyangs nas// sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan mngon du byas// de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa ni/ sems khong lhod klod la dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul thams cad bcad de mnyam par bzhag de'ang sems kyi gshis cir yang ma grub pa chos sku/ gdangs gang du'ang ma 'gags pa longs sku/ rtsal mos gus su dung nge ba sprul sku/

bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba ngo bo nyid kyi skur shes pa'i gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du sing nge bzhag go /rjes de las ldang ba na/ 'di bgyis dge bas zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam gong bzhin brjod do// //yang sngon chad gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras kyi khrid smin rgyas thob pa'i gang zag de'i dmigs pa rnams nyams su len par 'dod pas/ bla ma dang rang sems bsres pa de'i ngang las/ skad cig gis kye rdo rje rten brten par bcas man ngag ltar gsal btab nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa gang yin nyams su blangs nas/ rjes bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas gdab pa rnams gzhung bzhin bya ba yin no// de ltar bshad pa de dag las rang gang mos pa'i rnal 'byor te nyams su blangs na rgyud la tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs shing bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa sogs dal 'byor la snying po mchog blangs par 'gyur ba ni mi bslu ba ste/ bde mchog las/ de nas dngos po kun gyis ni// dang por slob dpon mnyes par bya// grub 'dod kun tu mnyam bzhag pas// ci nus pas ni bla ma mchod// ces dang*/ ci'i phyir snyam na/ gsang ba 'dus par/ de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi// ye shes mchog gi thob par 'gyur// gang zhig bskal pa bye bar ni// brgya phrag tu yang rnyed dka' ba// de nyid sangs rgyas brtson ldan la// skye ba 'di la stsol bar mdzad// ces bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pa rnams rjes su dran cing nyams su blangs pas rang dang gzhan gyi don chen po 'grub pa ni nges pa'o// smras pa/ grangs med bskal par pha rol phyin bcu yis// bsgrub byar bstan pa'i gtam gyis yid gdung tshe// gang gi drin gyis mi ring phyag rgya che// 'grub pa'i lam bzang rnyed de skal ba bzang*// rgyal kun mdzad pa bdag la sgrub byed po// rdo rje slob dpon sku drin che ba'i ljid// 'degs par ma bzod chu gter bying ba'i sa// chen po khab spu ldan pa'i 'jug pas bteg

/mos gus yul ni bslu ba'i skyabs gnas min// bsgom tshul man ngag mi ldan rang bzo min// rgyud la bskyed bya 'khor ba'i phun tshogs min// de phyir rnal 'byor 'di la gus par rigs// don gnyis mthar son chos gzugs sku yi rgyu// zab rgya che tshogs chu gter chen po yang*// bla ma la bsten tshe gcig rdzogs byed pa'i// mchod tshul sprin chen skal bzang mkha' la dkrigs// rnam dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu bdag gzhan kun// kun tu mi dge'i bshes kyis mi bslu zhing*// zhing gi dam pa bla ma lha ru shes// shes bya kun mkhyen rgyal po'i rgyur bsngo'o// zhes gsung ngag rin po che'i zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchod pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa tshogs gnyis chu gter rdzogs pa'i sprin chen zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gtsug lag zung gi mkhyen yangs dge slong dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis bskul ngor/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i chos kyi rgyal thabs skyong ba'i mkhan po chen po thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub zhal snga nas kyis mtshon/ yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa rnams kyi legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i gsung ngag rin po che'i dmigs rim gyi gsol 'debs zab don snying po gzhir gzhag der mi gsal ba rnams khrid gzhung gis kha bskangs te nyams su blang bde bar skye dgu'i bdag po'i lor/ sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa phyogs thams cad du dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// bka' drin che ldan bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang tshul dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gang zhig dgyes pa'i 'dzum zlas reg pa'i 'phral// bskal par bsgrub 'os byang chub snying po'i mdza'// brtan ldan nyid kyang tshe gcig 'grub nges pa'i// skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'khor lo'i mgon pos skyongs// rnam 'dren kun gyi yon tan bkod pa'i dpal// ji snyed gang skur rdzogs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar// 'gro ba smin mdzad rdo rje slob dpon mchog

/gus pas bsnyen 'di rgyal kun bgrod gcig lam// zab lam rnal 'byor srol chen mang po las// rang nyid sku drin rmad byung bla ma gcig /skyabs yul kun 'dus yid bzhin nor ltar bsten// gsol gdab dngos grub len pa'i cho ga 'dri// de'ang bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa'i bla ma dam pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul thun mong ma yin pa bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rang gi yi dam gyi lha gang yin gsal btab/ de'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung chos/ sku dge 'dun kun 'dus su bsams pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khod de skyabs su 'gro ba'i blos/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshigs bcad lhug pa gang rung blo dang 'dres nges pa bya'o// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po yul bskyed pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor rin chen seng ge'i khri// sna tshogs chu skyes nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen chos kyi rje// rnam pa rdo rje 'chang chen sku mdog sngo// phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol// 'dzum khro sgeg chags mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar// ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings dang lhag ma grol// dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes// sku las sna tshogs 'od kyi drwa ba 'phro// zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// phung lnga dbyings bcas rnam dag rgyal ba drug /khams lnga rig ma skye mched rtsa rgyus tshigs// sems dpa' che brgyad yul drug lha mo drug /tshigs chen bgegs 'dul khro bo bcu yi bdag /gnas gsum 'bru gsum yi ge'i 'od stong 'bar// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer pho nya 'phros// dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// bstan srung nor lha spyan drangs dbyer med thim// gang de skyabs yul kun 'dus bla ma'i mchog

/dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha yi dngos// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin nyid// lam mchog dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas che// tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi bdag /bar chad kun sel bstan srung rgya mtsho'i gtso// 'dod pa'i re skong nor lha'i rang bzhin nyid// 'khor lo'i mgon po drin chen rdo rje 'chang*// byang chub bar gyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du// spyi bor bzhugs nas byin gyis brlab par gyur// gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa dbul ba ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// skyabs kun gcig tu rdzogs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// 'gro ba 'tshang rgya'i rten 'brel zab mo'i skor// smin mdzad rdo rje slob dpon la phyag 'tshal// zhes dang*/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bstod pas kyang bstod/ bdag gzhan longs spyod lus dang dge ba'i sems// maṇ+ḍal dam par sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul// bka' dang dam tshig las 'das sdig ltung bshags// ci mdzad dge bar blta ba'i yi rang bgyi// theg mchog chos 'khor bskor zhing gzhan don du// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge ba ji snyed bdag gzhan sems can rnams// bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa mchog thob phyir bsngo// gsum pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dbang dang dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol// lus la bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol// ngag la gsang ba'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol// sems la gsum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol// rlung la bzhi pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol// rnam dag dbang gi cho ga las thob pa'i// mnyam rjes bza' bsrung mi 'bral dam tshig rnams// 'bad rtsol drag pos bsrung bsdam nus pa dang*// nyes ltung dri ma med par byin gyis rlobs// gsal stong zung 'jug rgyu yi bla ma dang*// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug lam gyi bla ma dang*// sprul chos longs sku 'bras bu'i bla ma gsum// dbyer med bla mar rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// bzhi pa dbang blang bas de kho na nyid la blo gzhag pa ni/

de ltar gsol btab 'khor lo'i mgon pos bdag /mkhyen brtse nus pas byin gyis brlabs bzhin du// 'od phung bde ba chen po'i rnam rol gyis// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum ro gcig 'dres// sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs dbang bzhi thob// sgo gsum sgrib pa bag chags bcas pa sbyangs// dam tshig sdom pa rnam par dag gyur nas// sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan mngon du gyur// ces brjod de/ sems khong lhod glod la dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul thams cad bcad de mnyam par bzhag pas/ sems kyi gshis cir yang ma grub pa bla ma chos sku/ gdangs gang du'ang ma 'gags pa longs sku/ rtsal mos gus su dung nge ba sprul sku/ bsgom bya sgom byed las 'das pa ngo bo nyid kyi skur shes pa'i gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du sing nge gzhag go /gsum pa ni de las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma la// rdo rje 'chang dngos rtogs pa'i mos gus kyis// dbang dang dngos grub rtag tu len par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam gang shes kyis mtha' brgyan par byas te nyams su blangs na bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug cing rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'byung bar gsungs so// smras pa/ dang por legs par 'gro ba'i lam dang mjal// bar du lam gyi yon tan ci yang bskyed// de mthar bsam bya'i 'bras bu mngon 'gyur ba// de kun rdo rje slob dpon bsten las 'byung*// bsten tshul phyogs lhung dad dang bab col tshig /mkhyen mkhyen bzlas brjod dgos pa 'grub srid na// ngal brgyas bsten dang bcos min mos gus mkhan// sngon rabs mkhas grub de dag ma 'khrul lam// 'di bgyis dge bas bdag dang sems can rnams// skyabs mchog bla ma gtsug gis gus bsten cing*// theg gsum bstan pa'i snying po yongs bzung nas// rnam 'dren bstan la mkhas pa'i las byed shog

/ces bka' drin che ldan bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang tshul dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba zhes bya ba 'di ni don du gnyer ba dag gi ngor/ myos ldan gyi lor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa don thams cad 'grub par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
